provenance.source_document: JT/T 1037-2022 公路桥梁结构监测技术规范; SJG 148-2024 桥梁结构健康监测技术标准; JTG/T 3365-01-2020 公路斜拉桥设计规范; JTG D60-2015 公路桥涵设计通用规范
provenance.scope: S01-S08 simulated cable-stayed bridge (main span L=120 m); per-measurement values in sensor_thresholds
provenance.notes: Student-competition design basis, not a formally approved production limit. Yellow=0.8x design (strain yellow proxies the historical-maximum rule until monitoring history exists), orange=1.0x design, red=1.2x design; red for strain/temperature/cable acceleration is a platform extrapolation (codes define no third level there). Cable acceleration follows SJG 148-2024 Table 8.3.6 (100 mg / 300 mg). S08 red = 60 °C paving-layer alarm limit (JT/T 1037-2022 Table 9). The approval interface is reserved: a future toB deployment sets approved_by, effective_date, and status=authoritative.
